author: Kairos I
title: Rebuild index + panels + text after adding kairos/v1
abstract: Adds Kairos v1 summary to lineage_summaries, then rebuilds master index, panels, and text summary.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, shlex
cmds = [
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/build_all.py",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/make_text_summary.py"
]
for cmd in cmds:
    print("RUN:", cmd)
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("RC:", rc)
